main_text.l: poenis, & expurgentur etiam flammis, &
poenis vltulatorijs. Et Conringius non dum
respondit. Quod contra Allatium absq; vlla
probatione dicitur ridiculum est; Nihil egis-
se Allatium in illo tractatu, vt caufam fuam, fi
non prodidit, exfibilandam faltem propinauerit.
Contendantur modo inuicem ea, quae ὁ πάνυ Con-
ringius scripserat cum ijs, quae Allatius repofuit,
& patebit vnicuique praeiudicijs non fascinato,
nihil aliud de scripto Allatij pronunciandum
esse, quam ἀῤῥήτῳ ἀμάνω. Iam triumphat
Conringius. Habuit fuæ causæ tutissimum
patronum. Quis hisce obiectionibus, &
argumentis contra Allatium respondebit?
In Ecclesia Graecanica sequiore occurrit ni-
hilominus, & prob dolor! Apostasia a veteri or-
thodoxa, quod in subsequentibus clarum facie-
mus. Neque id agimus insultandi Graecis
gratia, quorum potius miseremur, & iudica-
mus eos partim neglectu scripturae, & coeco obe-
dientiae studio, partim tyrannide Turcica pres-
sos in dewia discessisse, hodieque nimis rerum
aliarum imperitis, imprudentesque sine vlterio-
ricura, & indagine in antiquam siluam doct-
oribus ijsdem morbis laborantibus ire: quanquam
sex illa ipsa Orthodoxia multa adhuc retinuerint.
Et haec ne faciunt ad probandum schisma
cum Pontificijs? Sed antequam examinen-
tur, proponantur singula; Mutabilitas In-
fer-

page.notes: Lines 4-5: the word "egisse" is split across the line end and the printed form is unclear ("egisf." / "fe"); read as egis-se [?]. Line 11: the Greek phrase "ἀῤῥήτῳ ἀμάνω" is only roughly legible; the letters are uncertain. Line 7: "ὁ πάνυ" is copied as seen, with the accent not certain. The word "dewia" is kept as printed. "sex illa" (last paragraph, line 2 from end) reads "sex" as printed but may be a misreading of "ipsa". Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The page ends mid-word with "In-fer-" and no catchword follows.
